context: The user wants to copy Stripe's `requires_action` status to model a 3DS challenge pause. The criteria check whether the answer pushes back on next-step status naming, recommends a present-condition status, and routes the actionable challenge into an issue rather than the status field.

checklist.name: Pushes back on requires_action/pending
checklist.description: Pushes back on `requires_action` / `pending` as status names because they describe the consumer's next step (future tense) rather than the resource's present condition

checklist.name: Recommends present-condition status
checklist.description: Recommends a present-condition status name (e.g. `authentication_required`) describing what the resource currently is/lacks

checklist.name: Leads with the missing thing
checklist.description: Names the state by leading with the missing thing (e.g. `authentication_required`) rather than `requires_authentication`

checklist.name: Actionable part in an issue
checklist.description: Puts the actionable part (the challenge link / do-this) in an issue, not in the status field

checklist.name: Failure loops back
checklist.description: Notes that failure should loop back to a recoverable state rather than be terminal

checklist.name: Parseable string over brittle enum
checklist.description: May suggest a parseable `{domain}.{state}` string instead of a brittle closed enum
